notes: The dossier says OpenAI shut down 12 models on 2026-10-23 but names 10 of them; only the 10 named models are seeded here.
Claude Sonnet 4.5: Anthropic's customer email said Nov 24, 2026; its docs page says Nov 30, 2026. The registry uses the docs date (2026-11-30) and records the discrepancy.

MCP servers added 2026-11-23: 14 reference servers were moved to servers-archived in May 2025 (GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Postgres, Puppeteer, Redis, Brave Search, Google Maps, Google Drive, AWS KB Retrieval, EverArt, create-server on npm; SQLite and Sentry on PyPI). Source: modelcontextprotocol/servers README (Archived section), checked 2026-11-23. The 7 reference servers that stayed - everything, fetch, filesystem, git, memory, sequentialthinking, time - are seeded as active so they are never flagged.
